title: Launch Accelerator: micro SKUs, regional rollout telemetry, and release-notes sequencing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-functional go-to-market activities for the introduction of dedicated micro SKUs (lower-cost, lower-vCPU/GPU configurations) across two pilot regions (eu-west-3 and ap-south-1). This ticket centralizes release-note sequencing, telemetry gating, partner enablement, and launch-ready checklists. Deliverables: 1) finalized release notes bundle and sequencing plan, 2) telemetry signals and dashboards for early adoption health, 3) sales/CS enablement packet for reservation and flex options, 4) coordinated rollout calendar with staged enablement and feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in docs repository and scheduled in docs release train for dedicated-2026.04
Telemetry dashboard (Console and internal Grafana) shows 10 baseline signals: latency, P90 token cost, reservation utilization, cache hit rate, canary error rate, slow-start incidents
Sales kit and pricing sheet published to Drive and linked in internal Sales enablement playbook
Feature flag for micro SKUs toggled in console for pilot tenants and automated rollback path validated
Compliance signoff (legal + security) completed and documented
Support runbook and escalation matrix uploaded to Confluence with three worked examples

notes: Decision: We will ship micro SKUs as a complementary SKU family (not replacing existing families). This minimizes migration risk for current customers.
Trade-off: micro SKUs reduce per-instance throughput; recommended use-case is bursty/low-concurrency workloads. Documentation must show clear cost-performance comparisons.
Telemetry approach: two-phased. Phase 1 (canary) collects rich telemetry for pilot customers; Phase 2 (GA) surfaces aggregated metrics in Console to avoid PII leakage.
Rollback plan: route traffic off micro SKUs to match-compatible small SKU via smart routing policy within 15 minutes if error rate exceeds 3% for 10 minutes.
Pricing note: initial offering will include a 3-month early-adopter discount for reservations to incentivize capacity commits; finance to prepare margin impact analysis.
